style.name: Desert Modern
style.definition: Low horizontal furniture and sun-baked colors bring the calm of desert modernism into an urban home.
style.materials: sand linen; saddle leather; travertine; walnut; clay
style.living: sand low box sofa; saddle-leather sling chair; rectangular travertine coffee table; walnut slatted TV cabinet; compact rectangular walnut dining table with four saddle-leather chairs; clay dome pendant
style.bed: walnut platform queen; sand linen; rust woven throw; two walnut nightstands and clay table lamps; desert abstract art
style.solarium: teak sling lounge furniture with rust weatherproof pads; slatted teak dining set
style.implement: Let low silhouettes echo the long glazing; use terracotta in textiles and pots instead of replacing floors.
style.avoid: Avoid cacti as a theme or artificial desert architecture.
